verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say users can create workflows to automate their processes. Its AI agents, such as the Prospecting agent, are described as watching accounts and reaching out automatically, with smart deal progression keeping deals moving after every call, which is background, autonomous automation. Timed sequences add scheduled outreach. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of workflow triggers, scheduling and run behavior; documented limits or guardrails on agent autonomy; independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
